steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Status report.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Things aren't quite right. The Doctor's guess was a hit; a lot of people are gathered over here.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Are they setting out for the factories?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Yes... I'm sure of it.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Stay on their tails. Keep me informed.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: And that'll conclude this factory's handover.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Everything up till now has been as smooth as ice, thanks to your mediation, Doctor.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: I might have been a little neglectful beforehand. I'm very sorry for that.

options: Don't mind it, I'm just a scholar.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: My, no need to be so humble. There's plenty still to come that'll require your guidance.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Er, do you have some qualm about this, General Valais?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: An ambush.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: That's General Valais for you.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: We're here to get an explanation.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Weiss and the Doctor should have just conveyed to the subjects' representatives the steps Karlan Trade's taking.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: There must have been some misunderstanding...

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Misunderstanding?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Sorry, Mr. Chester, I think you don't get it.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Sir Enciodes was tricked by this foreigner!

options: Come again?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: We were all kept in the dark. We only realized what was happening once someone told us.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Mr. Chester, you should know this foreigner's 'original' purpose in Kjerag was to advise on Oripathy and Infected handling methods.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: What's your point?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Our informant is never wrong.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: This foreigner's already in cahoots with Arctosz, and it's your job to keep eyes on the 'guest', General Valais.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Everyone knows Arctosz and the Vine-Bead Court were never happy with how Sir Enciodes opened up Kjerag.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: The foreigner's going to say the factories spread Oripathy as an excuse to shut them forever with gross slander against the lord!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: You're the one speaking slander! The Paleroches would never stoop to such unsightly lows!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: The Paleroches and the Vine-Bead Court are all tied up! You don't think anything 'unsightly?' You don't think enough people have lost their lives?!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Father, Father! Are you alright?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Come, drink it. Drink and all will be better.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Kjeragandr's tears will cleanse this taint the Tschäggättä have left.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: What proof do you have?!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Pah! You're asking me to prove your own misdeeds?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Doctor, this...

options: Isn't true.
What do you think?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Can I trust you?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: What, hound got your tongue?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Don't think you can smooth-talk your way out of this!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: There's only one thing you need to say! Justify yourself to us!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Guards! Protect our guest! Take them away!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Get that foreigner now!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Wh-Where did you come from?!

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's not safe here!

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Time to run, Doctor!
The Ursus operator lifts you onto her shoulders, and leaps into the forest in giant bounds.

options: Um, you can stop running. Let's put me down.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Oh! Alright.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: *Pant*...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I need to reiterate, Doctor.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: No matter what plans you have, this is far too dangerous. You probably don't remember, but I've told you the same thing many, many times before.

options: Believe me, I believe you.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Anyone can make mistakes, even me. If you're willing, I hope you can make my work a bit easier on me.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The possibility's not high, but what would you have done if more professional combatants were snuck into that attack?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: If they brought crossbows, what then?

options: Don't worry, their goal isn't to kill me.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I'll report the situation to the Doctor.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Captain Sharp and I both followed your confidant's message, heading separately to the Browntails' residence and the Silverashes' factories to pursue suspicious personnel.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Our trails ended up converging into one, surprisingly enough...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: These people were very likely incited by the Browntails.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Agitating civilians and smearing the competition are both common schemes, but they're crude.

options: Seems it's to stir conflict between me and the Silverashes.
Seems it's to stir conflict between the Paleroches and Silverashes.
But it's also probably a trap.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Their equipment and combat strength aren't up to par. It's not even enough to get them out in one piece.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Suppose they were arrested and interrogated, and they gave up their source...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Then it would look bad for the Browntails?!

options: That's not the whole of it.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: We're lacking intel. We still can't see the full picture of this incident. No way to actually lock onto the hidden orchestrator or their goals.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The one thing we can be sure of is someone wants to disturb the tri-clan relations. That is to say, they want to shatter the Snow Realm's overall stability. Circumstances are exceptionally dangerous for outsiders like you, Doctor.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: What do we do now, Doctor? Should we think of some way to make it back first?

options: It's not time yet. This incident's far from over.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: That's right, this charade's just one small part of the giant storm. But my duty's clear-cut—I'm getting you out of danger, Doctor.

options: I'm going to get more info.
I'm going to evade capture.
I'm going to stop whoever's stirring up the clans.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The more you know, the more dangerous your situation. We likely won't have the time to ensure all the details, Doctor.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: That might just be the start of it, Doctor.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I have to remind you, Doctor, this may have long grown beyond your plans.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: But since you're so determined, and seeing as you have a good grasp on things... we won't stop you.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: At this point, do you plan on telling Courier and Matterhorn, and especially Cliffheart, considering they're all Silverashes?

options: No.
Up to you.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Agreed. I'm sorry to Cliffheart, but now that we're here, it's hard for me to fully trust Courier and Matterhorn.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Doctor, I know you want to trust them, but set aside Cliffheart for now—it's hard for me not to be wary of Courier and Matterhorn in this current tri-clan dispute, no matter what.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Then I choose to keep part of the truth hidden from them.

options: For now, take me back.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Is there anyone else?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: None, they've all been suppressed.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Then what about the Doctor? Whereabouts?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: We... saw someone taking the Doctor away, running into the forest.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Damn...!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: You lot, with me! There'd better not be a single scratch on—

options: Is it me you're looking for?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Ah! So you're... I thought you...

options: You thought I ran?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: That was a difficult situation there, and I lost sight of you. I hope you can forgive me.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I made a mockery of myself, when I should by all rights have prioritized your safety.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: As you can see... the people here have all been contained.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Don't move! Settle down!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Don't think we don't know! You're here just to frame Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: You self-righteous hypocrite! Pah!

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: ...Bro?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Lara? Why are you here?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Bro! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Wh—Why are you all mixed up with these people?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: That's my boss!

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Leave it. Now's not the time.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Understood, Captain.

options: To be honest, I have nitpicks with Karlan Trade's factory safety measures.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: What?

options: The exhaust pipes are too close to the construction area. The layout's pure nonsense.
The protective gear given to workers is too low-coverage.
The Originium transport channels aren't secure enough.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Have... you told Sir Enciodes about that?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: You! You! You're a nasty piece of work after all.

options: It's the truth.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I don't quite understand, so I have no way to judge if what you say is true.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: But it sounds at least somewhat reasonable.

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: I'll never believe your vile lies! You! You...

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I want you to behave or else! Have you given a thought to the sort of punishment you'll face for attacking an outside guest of honor in the Vine-Bead Court's territory?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: So long as it's for Sir Enciodes...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: The Silverashes' guest attacked by the Silverashes' subjects? Is there any way this won't smear the Silverash reputation?

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Is this how you 'repay Sir Enciodes?'

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: ...That...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Think about it!

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Bro, you used to be so cool-headed. What happened?

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: ...Forget it. You wouldn't understand if I told you.

options: General Valais. Let these people go.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: What?

options: As you see, my subordinate has a relative here.
This is a misunderstanding. Don't make it any bigger.
Consider it compensation for your mistake there.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: General Valais, please be kind...

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Is that really all it is? I'm not convinced.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: *Sigh*... You know what, forget it.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: ...Are you sure this settles it?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Listen up, all of you. If it wasn't for our guest's altruism, you'd all be in for a caning before the day is out! Reflect on your actions!

steps.name: Armed Subject
steps.text: Don't think you'll buy us off just like that! You rotten...

steps.name: Soldier Leader
steps.text: Leave it, leave it. We're out of here. Don't disgrace the Silverashes any more than that.
The furious subjects slowly leave, wearing expressions of disappointment and spite as they go. The most vitriolic clash, for the moment, has been defused.
A heavy blizzard is gathering at this moment, of that much you're sure.
